description: Active Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Use this as the reviewed candidate recipe.
goal: Test whether the Bullet/Reckless-like net can learn the broader move-choice failures seen in the rejected SPRT by training on all oracle-scored child positions from those games, mixed with the broad d12 Stockfish-labeled pool. This remains gate-only: train, sweep checkpoints, and do not run SPRT unless the SPRT-failure move-choice gate improves clearly.

inputs.rows_expected: about 2.99M broad + 5.07M SPRT-failure child rows = 8.06M rows

success_condition: SPRT-failure move-choice gate improves over the failed movechoice sb112 checkpoint
candidate top1/top3 moves materially closer to reference on failed-SPRT positions
worst move-choice tail does not introduce catastrophic 30k sentinel misses
static eval sign/MAE does not collapse relative to the 1M cp-only Bullet run
Enyo evalnet check passes after loading quantised.bin
no SPRT unless gates are clearly cleaner than prior cp-only/WDL checkpoints
next_after_success: run checkpoint sweep over selected superbatches
run evalnet check/bench on the best quantised.bin
run move-choice gate against repeated-tail and SPRT-failure positions
only consider SPRT if static slope/sign and move-choice gates are clean
